# google_vertex_ai_task_store

A TaskStore is a logical grouping, and IAM and configuration boundary, for
Agent2Agent (A2A) protocol tasks. It provides managed, persistent storage for
stateful, long-running agentic tasks on Agent Platform.

```hcl

  provider = google-nightly

  task_store_id = "task-store"
  region        = "global"
}
```

## Argument Reference

The following arguments are supported:


* `task_store_id` -
  (Required)
  The ID to use for the TaskStore, which will become the final component of
  the TaskStore resource name. This value may be up to 63 characters, and
  valid characters are `[a-z0-9-]`. The first character must be a letter,
  and the last character must be a letter or number.


* `display_name` -
  (Optional)
  Display name of the TaskStore.

* `description` -
  (Optional)
  Description of the TaskStore.

* `config` -
  (Optional)
  Configuration for the TaskStore.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_config).

* `type` -
  (Optional)
  The type of the TaskStore. This determines what protocol the TaskStore
  supports. Defaults to `A2A` if not specified. Possible values include:
  `A2A`.

* `encryption_spec` -
  (Optional)
  Customer-managed encryption key spec for this TaskStore. If set, this
  TaskStore and its sub-resources will be secured by this key. If not set,
  this TaskStore and its sub-resources will be secured by the default
  Google-managed encryption key. CMEK is not supported for TaskStores in
  the `global` location.
  Structure is [documented below](#nested_encryption_spec).

* `region` -
  (Optional)
  The location of the TaskStore, for example `global` or `us-east4`. If not
  set, the provider region is used.

* `project` - (Optional) The ID of the project in which the resource belongs.
    If it is not provided, the provider project is used.

* `deletion_policy` - (Optional) Whether Terraform will be prevented from destroying the resource. Defaults to DELETE.
	When a 'terraform destroy' or 'terraform apply' would delete the resource,
	the command will fail if this field is set to "PREVENT" in Terraform state.
	When set to "ABANDON", the command will remove the resource from Terraform
	management without updating or deleting the resource in the API.
	When set to "DELETE", deleting the resource is allowed.


<a name="nested_config"></a>The `config` block supports:

* `default_task_ttl` -
  (Optional)
  The default time-to-live (TTL) applied to tasks created in this
  TaskStore. A duration in seconds with up to nine fractional digits,
  ending with 's'. Example: `86400s`.

<a name="nested_encryption_spec"></a>The `encryption_spec` block supports:

* `kms_key_name` -
  (Required)
  The Cloud KMS resource identifier of the customer managed encryption
  key used to protect a resource. Has the form:
  `projects/my-project/locations/my-region/keyRings/my-kr/cryptoKeys/my-key`.
  The key needs to be in the same region as the TaskStore.

## Attributes Reference

In addition to the arguments listed above, the following computed attributes are exported:

* `id` - an identifier for the resource with format `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/taskStores/{{task_store_id}}`

* `name` -
  The resource name of the TaskStore, in the format
  `projects/{project}/locations/{location}/taskStores/{task_store}`.

* `create_time` -
  Timestamp when this TaskStore was created.

* `update_time` -
  Timestamp when this TaskStore was most recently updated.


## Timeouts

This resource provides the following
[Timeouts](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/plugin/sdkv2/resources/retries-and-customizable-timeouts) configuration options:

- `create` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `update` - Default is 20 minutes.
- `delete` - Default is 20 minutes.

## Import


TaskStore can be imported using any of these accepted formats:

* `projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/taskStores/{{task_store_id}}`
* `{{project}}/{{region}}/{{task_store_id}}`
* `{{region}}/{{task_store_id}}`
* `{{task_store_id}}`

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, use an [`identity` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/block/import#identity) to import TaskStore using identity values. For example:

```tf
import {
  identity = {
    region = "<-optional value->"
    taskStoreId = "<-required value->"
    project = "<-optional value->"
  }
  to = google_vertex_ai_task_store.default
}
```

In Terraform v1.5.0 and later, use an [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) to import TaskStore using one of the formats above. For example:

```tf
import {
  id = "projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/taskStores/{{task_store_id}}"
  to = google_vertex_ai_task_store.default
}
```

When using the [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import), TaskStore can be imported using one of the formats above. For example:

```
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_task_store.default projects/{{project}}/locations/{{region}}/taskStores/{{task_store_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_task_store.default {{project}}/{{region}}/{{task_store_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_task_store.default {{region}}/{{task_store_id}}
$ terraform import google_vertex_ai_task_store.default {{task_store_id}}
```
